title: AWKUM Conducts Fifth Day of Faculty Training on Blackboard LMS at Timergarah Campus
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) successfully conducted the

fifth day of faculty training on the Blackboard Learning Management System (LMS)

at its Timergarah Campus, as part of the University’s ongoing digital transformation initiative.

The training program was organized by the University’s
ERP Cell
following the
acquisition of the Blackboard LMS from the
Higher Education Commission (HEC)

under the ERP framework. The initiative aims to strengthen digital teaching, learning, and
assessment practices in line with contemporary academic standards.

Faculty members from various academic departments actively participated in the training
sessions, which focused on course creation and management, online teaching tools,
assessment mechanisms, grading systems, and strategies to enhance student engagement
through the Blackboard platform.

The University administration acknowledged and appreciated the support and cooperation of
the competent authority, Deans, Heads of Departments, faculty members, IT Team, campus
administration, Meeting Section, and the Offices of the Registrar and Treasurer for ensuring
the smooth and successful conduct of the training program.

Special appreciation was extended to the

Coordinator, Timergarah Campus, Dr. Minhaj Ud Din
, and the

Deputy Director IT, Mr. Arshad Ali
, for their valuable coordination and technical
support.
